measurement.inclusion: Only VBlank entries within each source-function entry-to-return epoch are distributed.

sourceClassification.VBlankIntr: The measured body is decomposed at direct call/return boundaries in main.c; every named component sums to entry-to-return exactly.
sourceClassification.callbacks: Select screen and field callbacks are separate source routines. Their observed cost is constant within each receipt, but their general cost remains state-dependent.
sourceClassification.gpuAndDma3: The buffered-register and DMA3 queue snapshots are source-visible inputs. Both are constant within each receipt, so neither explains its observed variation.
sourceClassification.audio: m4aSoundMain is the only measured VBlank-body stage with within-receipt variation. The captured audio state inventory covaries, but does not prove a field-minimal or causal reducer.
sourceClassification.resume: return-to-resume sits after VBlankIntr. One 59-cycle sample has no observed HBlank/VCount/Serial/Timer3 ROM ISR entry, so its additional 18 cycles remain an external event/resume-policy residual.

verdict: Evidence-only checkpoint: exact distributions and VBlankIntr stage accounting are reproducible, but no live reducer is licensed by this receipt.
